name: picoliter_ewd_droplet_manipulation
title: Low voltage picoliter droplet manipulation utilizing electrowetting-on-dielectric platforms
assay_type: EWD droplet dispensing, splitting, and bead/chemiluminescent reaction manipulation
targets: DI water droplet dispensing and splitting
paramagnetic bead droplet dispensing and splitting
affiliation: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Duke University, Durham, NC 27708, USA
protocol_summary: DI water droplets are dispensed on scaled 33 um and 21 um EWD electrodes and split into daughter droplets to characterize dispensing and splitting voltages at picoliter volumes (12-18 pl). Paramagnetic bead solution droplets are similarly dispensed and split to demonstrate bead manipulation. Luciferase buffer and luciferin/ATP substrate droplets are merged with the bead droplet and heated, then the chemiluminescent signal is measured, modeling the picoliter-scale pyrosequencing verification reaction described in the paper.
